title: Wave Functions
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly write down the antisymmetrized wave functions for the two-electron system.

title: Matrix Element Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly set up the expression for the matrix element involving the interaction Hamiltonian.

title: Correctness of Terms
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify and include all relevant terms in the matrix element expression.

title: Symmetry Argument
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide a clear explanation of the symmetry argument used to show the correctness of the matrix element expression.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors when writing the matrix element expression.
